items.t: Engine stalls or won't restart from failed fuel pump control module
items.note: Add a tow if it dies on the road.

items.t: Rough, delayed or lurching shifts from the 9-speed automatic
items.note: Software updates are cheaper; a complete transmission costs several thousand dollars.

items.t: Oil leak from the camshaft carrier seal
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes of about $3,000-$4,600; some shops pull the engine.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates with nothing ahead
items.note: Usually covered under warranty.

items.t: LED daytime running light goes dim or out
items.note: Some cars need the front bumper cover removed.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.note: One owner paid about $1,700 labor plus $300 parts; RepairPal lists $1,007-$1,309 on the same engine in the CT5. A full chain job costs more.

items.t: Coolant leak and overheating
items.note: One owner paid about $1,700 for a coolant leak repair. A head gasket costs far more.

items.t: Oil leak from the intake manifold gasket
Battery drains and car won't start
items.job: Replace 12-volt AGM battery and test for drain
items.note: One owner paid $425 at a dealer.

items.t: Front brakes squeal when backing up or on light stops
items.job: Apply anti-squeal fix or replace front pads
items.note: One dealer quoted $470 for the anti-squeal fix; another quoted about $1,800 for pads and rotors on all four wheels.

items.t: Instrument cluster and screens go dark
items.note: A software update may fix it first.

items.t: OnStar and emergency calling stop working
items.note: Covered under warranty on 2025 models.

items.t: Leaking struts or noisy front strut mounts
items.note: Add an alignment.

items.t: Check engine light from EVAP purge pump
items.note: One owner paid about $672 at a dealer.

items.t: Transmission won't shift into 9th gear
Sunroof glass shatters
items.note: Often covered by comprehensive insurance.

items.t: Start/stop accumulator may be missing bolts (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rearview camera image drops out (recall)
items.job: Update or replace video processing module
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake assist can be lost (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Over-cured tires can fail (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rear seat belt retractor may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear belt retractors
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Driver seat frame weld may be faulty (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace seat cushion frame
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Passenger airbag cover may lack tear seam (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.
